claim_text: The project is not an exact numerical reproduction of the paper.
allowed_wording: Exact numerical replication is not claimed.
prohibited_wording: The paper was exactly reproduced numerically.
limitations: Original raw outputs, candidate ordering, model snapshots, and runtime are not all available.

claim_text: The cleanup_current gate is green and cleanup is terminally closed for F6J entry.
allowed_wording: The exact F6J preflight gate passed with 140 passed and 1698 deselected.
prohibited_wording: The earlier 129 passed and 2 failed state is current.
limitations: This is a process validation claim, not a scientific metric.

claim_text: In the adapted paired setting, local LLM utility is generally below traditional baselines.
allowed_wording: LLM utility is generally lower in the adapted paired evidence.
prohibited_wording: LLMs are universally worse under the exact paper protocol.
limitations: Paired intersections and local baselines are adapted.

claim_text: The adapted evidence does not support a general reranking advantage over ranking.
allowed_wording: Reranking advantage is contradicted in the adapted evidence.
prohibited_wording: Reranking is better than ranking in all local cells.
limitations: LastFM reranking LLM cells are blocked because raw responses are absent.

claim_text: LLMRank does not reliably improve over Base in the adapted local evidence.
allowed_wording: Base-versus-LLMRank is model, dataset, and task dependent and mostly negative in the adapted evidence.
prohibited_wording: LLMRank is always better than Base.
limitations: Prompt adapters and invalid outputs are part of the measured local protocol.

claim_text: Structured indexed output is a useful local adaptation for parser validity and reliability auditing.
allowed_wording: Structured indexed output enabled offline parsing and reliability measurement.
prohibited_wording: Structured output exactly reproduces the paper raw-output protocol.
limitations: It improves measurement but does not eliminate every invalid output.

claim_text: Long-tail APLT evidence supports a qualified adapted long-tail claim.
allowed_wording: APLT supports qualified adapted long-tail behavior.
prohibited_wording: APLT is a paper-exact popularity-bias result.
limitations: The population and candidate pools are adapted.

claim_text: Novelty evidence is positive but only partially paper-aligned.
allowed_wording: Novelty is a reconstructed-input result with qualified support.
prohibited_wording: The exact paper novelty result is reproduced.
limitations: Popularity and self-information inputs are reconstructed.

claim_text: Serendipity evidence is opposite to the paper claim under the reconstructed local definition.
allowed_wording: Serendipity is contradicted only for the reconstructed MostPop-hit readout.
prohibited_wording: The paper serendipity result is exactly falsified.
limitations: Formula and primitive reconciliation remains open.

claim_text: Candidate-position effects are observable but not yet causal CandDif evidence.
allowed_wording: Position sensitivity is an observational diagnostic result.
prohibited_wording: CandDif has been fully reproduced causally.
limitations: Controlled pair inputs are missing for full CandDif.

claim_text: LastFM reranking LLM utility cells remain blocked without new inference or released raw responses.
allowed_wording: LastFM reranking is unresolved because no existing raw responses are available.
prohibited_wording: LastFM reranking LLM metrics are complete.
limitations: F6J forbids new inference and raw-output creation.

claim_text: Cost and efficiency claims cannot be made as current official cost claims from existing placeholders.
allowed_wording: Existing cost and runtime files are planning or estimate evidence only.
prohibited_wording: The project has current official API cost measurements.
limitations: No current price verification or measured runtime audit was performed in F6J.

claim_text: ILD, coverage, calibration, popularity, duplicate@5, and novelty diagnostics are local extensions unless a row separately proves paper exactness.
allowed_wording: These diagnostics are scientifically useful local extensions.
prohibited_wording: All beyond-utility diagnostics are paper-exact reproductions.
limitations: Metric definitions and populations vary by metric family.

claim_text: LastFM trainable-baseline evidence is adapted and available for ranking, while LastFM reranking LLM cells are blocked.
allowed_wording: LastFM ranking trainable baselines are available as adapted evidence; LastFM reranking LLM cells are not.
prohibited_wording: All LastFM tasks are complete for every model family.
limitations: Task coverage differs by model family and raw-output availability.
